verdict.rationale: Deel exposes a broad REST API (contracts, payroll, people, time-off) plus an MCP server with tools mapping to API operations, suggesting substantial UI/API parity, and provides a sandbox for safe testing. However, there's no explicit documentation claiming full 1:1 parity between every UI action and API/MCP tool coverage, and community feedback highlights workflow rigidity and bugs suggesting gaps between advertised and actual capability. missing for 10: explicit parity statement or comprehensive tool/endpoint coverage list matching all UI functions, independent verification that no UI-only features exist.
